run.description: Generates a random string of payloadSizeBytes length and round-trips it through perf-callee-demo's echoPayload action over ServiceClient.invoke -- the same isRemoteThread path lib/service-client.js branches on options.directPeerChannels for. Returns the round-trip duration measured server-side, around just the ServiceClient.invoke call (excluding this action's own HTTP/session overhead). Benchmark fixture only, not part of any documented public API.
